Banking, payments and microfinance apps

Cards, transfers, payments and loans in one secure app, so customers do not need to visit a branch. An MVP in 12–20 weeks, from UZS 420 mln; the full version in 28–52 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Onboarding with MyID
  • Humo and Uzcard card linking
  • P2P transfers and bill payments through your processing partner
  • History
  • Push and SMS one-time codes
  • Security baseline (certificate pinning, root detection, encryption)
What the full version adds
  • Loans and deposits
  • Installment purchases
  • Cashback
  • In-app chat support
  • Fraud signals
  • Penetration test
  • Reporting hooks for the regulator
  • Backend for high load
Please note

The licence and the processing contract stay with your organisation; we build to your security policy and Central Bank requirements.

What we need from you

  • App Store and Google Play accounts
  • Logo, colours and texts
  • One person who makes the decisions

Questions

What does “Banking, payments and microfinance apps” cost?
The MVP costs $35,000–70,000 (UZS 420–845 mln), the full version $100,000–250,000 (UZS 1,200–3,005 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Banking, payments and microfinance apps” take?
The MVP takes 12–20 weeks, the full version 28–52 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
App Store and Google Play accounts; logo, colours and texts; one person who makes the decisions.
